Vitamin B12
(cobalamin)
Eat B12 fortiﬁed breakfast cereals, nutritional
yeasts, and other fortiﬁed products.
Supplements: most multivitamins-mineral
supplements such as B-complex vitamin
products contain B12, and a single product
contain vitamin B12 higher levels in the form of
cyanocobalamin. Other common forms include
adenosylcobalamin, methylcobalamin, and
hydroxycobalamin.
9–13 years: 1.8 mcg
14þ years: 2.4 mcg
9–13 years: 1.8 mcg 14þ years: 2.4 mcg
Vitamin D
Drink cow milk or plant milks fortiﬁed with
vitamin D. Increase intake of vitamin D irradiated
mushrooms.
Consume vitamin D fortiﬁed breakfast cereals,
orange juice, and milk substitutes.
Supplements: most multivitamin-mineral
supplements or as a single nutrient vitamin in
the form of D2 (ergocalciferol) and D3
cholecalciferol). * Vitamin D is more readily
absorbed when consumed with a meal or snack
that contains fat.
9–70 years: 15 mcg (600 IU)
70þ years: 20 mcg (800 IU)

Zinc
Increase consumption of beans and nuts by
adding them to meals and salads. Consume
whole grains and zinc fortiﬁed breakfast cereals
